description: Java source code for a tenant service that manages tenant data stored in memory backed by a file, including loading and saving tenant data, adding, removing, and updating tenants, with support for concurrency, versioning, and resource validation.

classes.name: FileBasedTenantService
classes.description: A tenant service implementation that keeps all data in memory and persists it to a file, supporting tenant management operations such as add, get, update, and remove, with lifecycle management and file persistence features.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes the service, loads tenant data from specified file if configured, and sets up periodic persistence.

methods.name: loadTenantData
methods.description: Loads tenant data from file into memory during startup.

methods.name: checkFileExists
methods.description: Checks if the tenant file exists, creates it if missing and configured to do so.

methods.name: addAll
methods.description: Adds multiple tenants to in-memory store from a JSON buffer.

methods.name: addTenant
methods.description: Adds a single tenant from a JSON object to the in-memory store.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the service, optionally saving data to file.

methods.name: saveToFile
methods.description: Persists all tenant data in memory to the specified file.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves tenant data by tenant ID.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Retrieves tenant data with additional span context.

methods.name: getTenantResult
methods.description: Constructs the result object with tenant data and status code.

methods.name: getTenantObjectResult
methods.description: Converts tenant data into JSON response format.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a tenant by ID with optional version check.

methods.name: removeTenant
methods.description: Performs the internal tenant removal logic with version validation.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new tenant, generating ID if needed, with conflict checks.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates existing tenant data, validating version and CA conflicts.

methods.name: convertTenant
methods.description: Converts tenant object to JSON representation, with optional filtering.

methods.name: getByCa
methods.description: Finds tenant by trusted CA subject DN.

methods.name: getCacheDirective
methods.description: Returns cache control directive based on configuration.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears all tenants from in-memory store.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the service.

methods.name: generateTenantId
methods.description: Generates a new UUID tenant ID not already in use.

methods.name: checkResourceVersion
methods.description: Verifies that the provided expected resource version matches the actual version.
